name.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (life insurance)

benefitSummary.en: Rs 2 lakh to the family on death from any cause. Premium Rs 436 a year, auto-debited from the bank account (less if joining later in the year). No claim for non-accidental death in the first 30 days after joining.
benefitSummary.hi: किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु होने पर परिवार को 2 लाख रुपये। साल का सिर्फ़ 436 रुपये, जो बैंक खाते से अपने आप कटता है।
benefitSummary.mr: कोणत्याही कारणाने मृत्यू झाल्यास कुटुंबाला 2 लाख रुपये. वर्षाला फक्त 436 रुपये, जे बँक खात्यातून आपोआप कापले जातात.

applyAt: Your bank or post office branch

applyAtSpoken.hi: अपनी बैंक शाखा या डाकघर में
applyAtSpoken.en: to your bank branch or post office

notes: Cover year 1 June to 31 May. Pro-rata premium: Jun-Aug Rs 436, Sep-Nov Rs 342, Dec-Feb Rs 228, Mar-May Rs 114.
One account per person only. Aadhaar is the primary KYC.
Cover can continue up to age 55 if joined before 50 and premium keeps being paid.
